misprints.note: Syllable doubled across the line break (τρέπε-|πεσθαι).
Two full stops printed after g.
No breathing printed on έπεσθαί; kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The full stop sits raised, like a middle dot, before the colon; I transcribed it as the usual ".:".
The line-end hyphen in γίγνε-σθαι prints as a mid-dot. I took it as a hyphen and wrote the word whole.
The breathing on υ is small; it reads as rough (αὑτοῦ), though smooth (αὐτοῦ) is possible.
There is no punctuation after χωρεῖν or after g at the line ends; it may have dropped out in printing. I kept it as printed.
